entry.title: Hunkemöller by Vogue | Heritage Collection Runway Show

media:group.media:title: Hunkemöller by Vogue | Heritage Collection Runway Show
media:group.media:description:
140 years. One unforgettable night.
Step inside Hunkemöller by Vogue, a celebration of 140 years of Hunkemöller and the debut of our limited-edition Heritage Collection.
Inspired by our archives and reimagined for today, the collection brings together intricate lace, sculptural corsetry, delicate embroidery and the craftsmanship that has defined Hunkemöller since 1886.
From an intimate dinner and immersive exhibition to the exclusive runway show, this evening brought our heritage to life in a celebration of fashion, innovation and timeless femininity.
🤍 Discover the Heritage Collection: https://bit.ly/47t2Aqp

media:group.media:title: 140 Years of Hunkemöller | Loved Since 1886
media:group.media:description:
From a small atelier in Amsterdam in 1886 to women across the world today, this is 140 years of Hunkemöller.
A story of craftsmanship. Of comfort. Of evolving with every generation of women; their lives, their styles, and the way they want to feel.
Because lingerie was never just about appearance. It’s about movement, comfort, and the feeling you return to.
Thank you for choosing us, again and again. Loved since 1886. And this is only the beginning.
Discover our heritage: https://bit.ly/4vTtrWK
#Hunkemoller140 #LovedSince1886
